name: Swimming in a Straw Fountain
author: DGP
bootlegger: 1 good player has an out-of-play character's ability in addition to their own & knows this. They might register as either character. If a Minion publicly guesses them (once), their team loses.
If the Bootlegger-chosen player is drunk or poisoned, both of their abilities are affected.
If the Cannibal eats the Bootlegger-chosen player, the Cannibal gains both of their abilities.
